gallery-gray.$description: Gallery Gray — Page background, header field, and low-contrast section canvas

porcelain.$description: Porcelain — Review cards, floating navigation surface, and light content panels

instrument-ink.$description: Instrument Ink — Hero headlines, long-form headings, body copy, and dark product-media fields

charcoal-type.$description: Charcoal Type — Secondary headings, testimonial quotes, and strong supporting text

slate.$description: Slate — Muted explanatory copy and low-emphasis labels

graphite.$description: Graphite — Footer links and subdued inline navigation

dial-teal.$description: Dial Teal — Large feature-card surface and illuminated dial treatment — a soft aqua interruption in the otherwise achromatic gallery

mint-glass.$description: Mint Glass — Text-highlight bands, pale feature surfaces, and the soft aqua wash behind selected review phrases

evergreen-dial.$description: Evergreen Dial — Occasional clock-dial feature surface; reserve for isolated product artwork rather than general interface states

machine-night-gradient.$description: Machine Night Gradient — Dark clock and product-media atmosphere, fading from metallic gray into Instrument Ink

icy-display-gradient.$description: Icy Display Gradient — Pale luminous treatment for aqua product callouts

luminous-teal-gradient.$description: Luminous Teal Gradient — Radial glow within dial-focused graphics and illuminated product details

ui-sans-serif.$description: Use the native system sans throughout. Headlines use 600 weight with increasingly negative tracking as they grow: -0.2px at 40px, -1px at 60px, and -1.2px at 96px; this makes the large statements feel cut from one dense typographic plane rather than like marketing display type. Quotes remain 400 at 32px/38.4px, preserving a conversational counterweight to the compact heavy headings.
